2610.08363.title: Explainable Failure Prediction and Prevention in Maritime
2610.08363.paper_summary: Maritime systems operate in highly dynamic environments where unexpected equipment failures can compromise safety, reliability, and operational efficiency. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, digital twins, and predictive maintenance enable proactive failure prediction and prevention. However, ensuring trustworthy and explainable decision-making remains a major challenge in safety-critical maritime applications. This chapter reviews key AI technologies required for explainable failure prediction and prevention in maritime systems and presents a conceptual architecture capable of supporting autonomous or human-in-the-loop corrective actions. This architecture integrates data acquisition, time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, risk assessment, decision-making, and explainable AI into a closed-loop framework. With reference to the architectural components, a review and discussion of relevant maritime studies is performed, outlining their methods, advantages, and limitations. Furthermore, it highlights current challenges, including uncertainty and robustness, model generalization, explainability, limited availability of maritime datasets, and operational deployment, and identifies future research directions toward trustworthy AI-assisted maritime decision-making.
2610.08363.paper_summary_zh: 海洋系統在高度動態的環境中運作，意外的設備故障可能會危及安全、可靠性和運營效率。最近在人工智慧（AI）、機器學習、數位雙胞胎和預測性維護方面的進展使得主動故障預測和預防成為可能。然而，確保可靠和可解釋的決策仍然是安全關鍵的海洋應用中的一大挑戰。本章回顧了海洋系統中所需的關鍵AI技術，以實現可解釋的故障預測和預防，並提出了一個能夠支持自主或人機協作的糾正行動的概念架構。該架構將數據獲取、時間序列預測、異常檢測、風險評估、決策制定和可解釋的AI整合到一個閉環框架中。參考架構組件，對相關的海洋研究進行了回顧和討論，概述了它們的方法、優勢和局限性。此外，它還突出了當前的挑戰，包括不確定性和穩健性、模型泛化、可解釋性、海洋數據集的有限可用性以及運營部署，並確定了未來朝向可信的AI輔助海洋決策的研究方向。
